name: SpeedOx
author: Mohsin Webs

sections.description:
SpeedOx is a powerful and lightweight performance optimization plugin for WordPress. It helps speed up your site with intelligent caching, automatic cache cleaning, CSS/JS minification, lazy loading, and advanced database optimization—all with a user-friendly dashboard that works out-of-the-box.

SpeedOx is designed to be compatible with most themes and plugins, including WooCommerce, without requiring complex configuration. Whether you’re a beginner or pro, SpeedOx makes performance tuning easy and effective.

Key Benefits:

  • ✅ Boost PageSpeed scores and Core Web Vitals
  • ⚡ Faster page load times with smart cache
  • 🔒 Fully secure and GDPR-conscious
  • 🧠 No coding knowledge required

Features

General Optimization Features:

  • Page Cache (Disk-based)
  • Cache Preloading
  • Minify HTML, CSS & JS
  • Combine CSS/JS
  • Defer or Delay JS
  • Lazy Load images & iframes
  • Database Cleaner & Optimizer
  • Remove Emoji & Embed scripts
  • GZIP/Brotli Compression (if server supports)
  • Browser Caching
  • DNS Prefetch & Preconnect
  • Heartbeat Control
  • Support for custom exclude/include rules
  • Automatic full cache purge every 6 hours to keep content fresh

Advanced Features:

  • Mobile and desktop cache split
  • Smart automatic purge of cache
  • Critical CSS generation (manual)
  • Multisite compatible
  • Custom CDN integration
  • Full compatibility with popular plugins like WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, and Contact Form 7
  • Simple import/export of settings
  • One-click cache cleaner and reset
  • Admin Activity Logs
  • Automatic full cache purge every 6 hours to keep content fresh

Privacy

SpeedOx stores optimization settings and logs locally on your site. It does not collect or transmit personal visitor data. All cached content is temporary and can be purged any time.

We comply with GDPR guidelines and no external data is stored or shared.

Credits

SpeedOx is proudly developed and maintained by mohsinwebs

License

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later. You’re free to use, modify, and distribute.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP or install directly via WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to “SpeedOx” menu in your admin dashboard and start optimizing!
sections.faq:
How does SpeedOx improve speed?

SpeedOx uses smart caching, minification, and optimization techniques to reduce load times and server response.

Do I need coding skills?

Not at all! SpeedOx is beginner-friendly and fully guided.

Is SpeedOx compatible with my theme or builder?

Yes, SpeedOx is compatible with most WordPress themes and page builders.

Does SpeedOx work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. It is optimized to work seamlessly with WooCommerce stores.

How can I report bugs or suggest features?

Please visit our support forum or contact us directly.
